attributes.board_name: Kansas Department for Aging and Disability Services, Health Occupations Credentialing

rules.accepted_credit_types: Secretary-approved sponsors, or sponsors approved by ASHA or the American Academy of Audiology (1 ASHA/AAA CEU = 10 clock hours); academic coursework (1 semester credit = 15 h, trimester 14, quarter 10; audited 8/7/5); new presentations 2 h per contact hour; new college course 6 h (max 12); supervising a postgraduate professional experience 5 h (max 5); pre-approved self-study with a test; poster displays max 2 h. In-service, marketing, personal development, time management, human relations, collective bargaining and tours do not count
rules.new_licensee_rule: If the initial licensure period is shorter than 24 months: 1 clock hour per month (single license) or 1.25 per month (dual license).
rules.audit_note: A summary of CE is submitted on the approved form with the renewal application; keep documentation (certificates, ASHA/AAA registry letter or transcript) for review.
rules.notes: Licensees holding both SLP and audiology licenses need 30 hours. One clock hour = at least 50 minutes of direct instruction. Full licenses expire biennially on October 31 (the year depends on the issue date). Lapsed up to 5 years: reinstatement with 20 contact hours in the past two calendar years. Read from the 2022 official K.A.R. volume (28-61-5 last amended 2010); the current rules.ks.gov and KDADS pages could not be loaded, so re-verify for amendments.

rules.audit_note: Keep records of CE hours or CEUs for four years and provide them on request (2026 Session Laws ch. 30, sec. 3).
rules.notes: New license created by the Speech-Language Pathology Assistant Licensure Act (HB 2761, approved April 3, 2026): 12 hours of approved CE or 1.2 CEUs per two-year licensing period; licenses expire after two years. Title protection starts January 1, 2027; reporting forms and further rules are to be set by the Secretary. Supervising SLPs need at least 2 hours of professional development in supervision or clinical instruction after licensure.
rules.legal_basis: 2026 Session Laws of Kansas ch. 30 (HB 2761), sec. 2-3
